purpose: Teach: 何気ない/あかね/たぐい/一回り/こじんまり/さかん/にこにこ/ひとえに

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの何気ない優しさに励まされるのよ
lines.en: Sho, you know — your big sister's quiet kindness just lifts me up.
lines.style: Warm, almost to herself. A soft, genuine observation. Slow, unhurried pace. Slight smile in the voice without performing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、あかね色のクレヨンで夕焼け描いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I drew the sunset with a crimson crayon.
lines.style: Small, proud voice. Careful — he wants her to understand what he made. Slight upturn at the end, testing her reaction. No rush.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの絵は、たぐいまれな雰囲気を持ってるのよ
lines.en: Sho, the way you draw — it has something rare in it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine. She's noticing something true about him. Slow enough to land. Warm but not effusive. Eyes on him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、もう一回り背伸びしてみるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to try standing a little taller.
lines.style: Soft determination. He means it — not boasting, but resolving something small to himself. Slight pause before 'taller.' Voice steady and sincere.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはこじんまりしたカフェが好きなのよ
lines.en: Sho, I love small quiet cafes like that.
lines.style: A gentle aside, almost thinking aloud. She's sharing something she notices about herself. Unhurried. Tender without needing acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祭りがさかんな町に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to a town where there's a festival happening.
lines.style: Bright, reaching forward. A child's gentle boldness — not demanding, but hopeful. Light in the chest. The kind of wish you share with someone you trust.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはにこにこ笑うのが素敵ね
lines.en: Sho, the way you smile — it's so lovely.
lines.style: Simple, genuine praise. No performance. Direct warmth, like she's giving him something true to hold. Slight softness on 'lovely.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ひとえにメイ姉さんのおかげで絵が好きになったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I love drawing now — and that's all because of you.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. He's saying something important. Each word distinct. Voice steady and clear. The kind of statement a child makes when he's thought about it beforehand.
